attributes.board_name: Michigan Task Force on Physician's Assistants (LARA Bureau of Professional Licensing)

rules.alternatives: Board FAQ: Michigan statute and rules currently require no continuing education for renewal; the licensee is responsible for maintaining competence. Only the mandated trainings below apply.

topics.who: All licensees: 1 hour for each year of the license cycle (not one-time)
All licensees: one-time training in identifying victims of human trafficking (R 338.6103)
Controlled substance licensees / PAs licensed to prescribe or dispense controlled substances: opioids and controlled substances awareness training (R 338.3135)

rules.notes: Renewal cycle 3 years; renew online no sooner than 90 days before expiration. Fee $181.80 (+$248.10 controlled substance license). Trainings are certified on the renewal application.
